apps.title: Try the OpenChat native app
apps.sub: The Android app is in beta. Pick the build you want below — the iOS app is on its way.
apps.whichBuild: There are two builds of the app. Which would you like?
apps.pickOne: Pick one and stick with it — the two builds can’t be installed together.
apps.playStoreBody: Installs and updates through Google Play. A couple of features are trimmed to meet store rules.
apps.fullBody: Everything, including the wallet and token features. You install the APK yourself and it keeps itself up to date.
apps.iosBuilding: The iOS app is being built now and will go out through TestFlight when it’s ready.
apps.safari: In the meantime OpenChat runs nicely in Safari — open {site} and add it to your home screen from the share menu.

features.title: A full messenger — with crypto built in, not bolted on.
features.communitiesBody: Bring a whole project together: public and private channels, user groups, roles and permissions in one place.
features.cryptoBody: Tip, pay or split with CHAT, ICP, ckBTC and more — as easily as sending a message. Swaps happen right in the app.
features.noPhoneBody: Sign in with a passkey or Internet Identity. Your account isn’t tied to a SIM card, an email or a big tech login.
features.gatesBody: Let in only token holders, verified people or members who pay — checked automatically, re-checked on your schedule.
features.callsBody: Diamond members can jump from a chat into a video call with the whole group, then back into the conversation.
features.botsBody: Add bots for reminders, prompts and moderation, or connect your own tools with webhooks.

communities.title: Find your people. Or start the place they gather.

governance.title: No company decides what OpenChat becomes. Its users do.
governance.body: OpenChat is governed by the OpenChat DAO. Every upgrade, feature and treasury decision is a public proposal that CHAT holders vote on — and the code only changes once it passes.
governance.proposeBody: A change to the app, a feature, or how the treasury is spent.
governance.voteBody: Staked CHAT gives voting power; votes are public and on-chain.
governance.shipBody: The DAO upgrades OpenChat’s canisters itself — no one can skip the vote.

cta.title: Your first chat is one passkey away.
cta.body: No phone number, no email required. Free to use, with Diamond for more storage and bigger groups.

footer.tagline: Fully featured. Fully yours. A decentralised messenger, owned by its users.
footer.governed: Governed by the OpenChat DAO · runs on the Internet Computer

roadmap.sub: A summary of OpenChat’s past, present and future. We don’t keep a fixed roadmap, so what comes next can change at any point, and the DAO has the final say.
